value.rationale: Four-tap third-order and six-tap fourth-order Keys interpolation are natural competing resampling kernels, with known distinct reproduction orders. The sharp discrete-to-continuous BV amplification of the six-tap kernel is a motivated, apparently un-tabulated stability invariant directly quantifying preservation of sharp edges and ringing. It yields the exact nontrivial increase (43 sqrt(43)-100)/1458 relative to the four-tap design, not a renamed known value or arbitrary parameter slice. No generalized downstream theorem is claimed.
